title: people-ops
text:
people-ops

Jamie Ortiz: Heads up — accepted a remote role and spouse accepted in Madrid. Planning to relocate 2026-08-01. Questions: do I toggle homebase now? impact on WFH stipend, US benefits, FSA/HSA, and parental leave pending?
Nina (People Ops): Congrats! If you change homebase mid-month stipend prorates based on effective date. If you remain on US payroll, benefits/leave continue; moving to local payroll stops US 401(k)/HSA.
Carlos (Payroll): Payroll cutover needs ~4 weeks. Fill form: https://redwood.internal/hr/homebase-change and select "retain US payroll" if you want temporary retention. We'll need exact dates and visa status to model taxes.
Lina (Benefits): HSA/FSA access depends on US tax filing and active enrollment; carriers often suspend contributions while on local payroll. I can open a benefits case and pull plan portability notes.
Jamie Ortiz: Prefer to keep US payroll for ~60 days to get settled. Also have big household items to ship — any relocation help?
Nina (People Ops): We don’t have standard voluntary relocation packages; we can pre-approve one-off reimbursements case-by-case. DM me estimates and I’ll confirm.
Carlos (Payroll): If you stay on US payroll for 60 days, 401(k) deferrals and employer match continue during that window. Stipend proration example will be in the payroll model.
Nina (People Ops): Next steps: 1) Jamie submit Homebase Change form and select retain option, 2) Carlos will run payroll/proration scenarios, 3) Lina will open benefits case, 4) Nina to pre-approve shipping estimate. I’ll schedule a 30-min sync Tue 9am PT.
Jamie Ortiz: Thanks everyone — will submit the form today and DM the shipping estimate.
